thesis: The site is a Gulf-coast season guide: every section is pinned to the months when Pinellas renters actually need storage, and a tide-calendar band runs through the page like a waterline.

signature.name: tide-calendar
signature.summary: Horizontal twelve-month tide curve with coral current-month dot; months light up per story via --sw-p. Reused in hero, four season stories, review month pills, and footer reset. Hook: data-sw-signature='tide-calendar'.

palette.family: Pinellas Sand + Tide Teal + Sunset Coral

motion.intro: Cover photo settles from 1.05x zoom; cover lines slide up staggered; tide curve draws left-to-right in <=1s.
stories: Pinned tide calendar band lights story months via --sw-p on desktop >=640px
Sizer floor plan draws outline and drops items in on selection
motion.hover: Coral underline grows from left via scaleX on links and cover lines
